generate_ball_depthmap: generate a depthmap simulating a ball contact at a given xyz position
create_tacto_renderer: create a TACTO Renderer with specified width, height, and digit sensor config path
render_from_depth: render color and depth images from a depthmap using the TACTO renderer
get_digit_config_path: get the file path to the TACTO digit sensor configuration
run_demo_render: run the demo to render and plot a ball contact imprint using TACTO
